We are planning next 3-4 years to get this 0.5-million-ton smelter commissioned. 4 years maybe hardly it will take

items.statement: Alumina production target raised to 2.25 mt from 2.046 mt last year, adding 200,000 tonnes calcined alumina for export
items.quote: Last year we have done calcined alumina around 20,46,000. And this year we have planne d 22,50,000. Straightaway 2,00,000 increase in alumina production

items.statement: Plan to reduce ingot share (70%) and add 1 lakh tonnes wire rods and foil products to improve premium over LME
items.quote: Our plan is also to have one lakh tons of wire rods and to go into foil products. This we are planning to do. Reducing ingots and going more into Value-Added Products. We are planning to do that. If we get that, only then we will be able to increase our premium.

items.statement: Government mandate to achieve 30% green power by 2030; Green Energy cell exploring sources
items.quote: That is the mandate given by the Government, that by 2030, we have to go for 30% of green power. We are already planning to have some of the Green Power Plants or sourcing from other areas, already our Green Energy cell is there. They are exploring the areas from where we can get more and more green power. The target will definitely be achieved by 2030.

items.statement: India net importer of alumina; domestic demand growing double-digit; aluminium demand seen >9 mt by 2030
items.quote: If you see the data by 2030, I think the aluminum requirement of India will be more than 9 million tons. So, there is a huge demand. So, to meet this gap of almost 4 million tons, now we are producing high. So, you require a huge quantity of bauxite as well as alumina. So, there is a great market in the future for alumina.

items.statement: Exported 36 ships calcined alumina last year; targeting 40-43 ships this year
items.quote: Last year we have exported around 36 ships. And this year we will be doing more than maybe 40 to 43 ships.

items.statement: Bauxite reserves: Panchpatmali ~150 mt; new Pottangi mine ~111 mt (20-50 mtpa for 20 years)
items.quote: Our reserves of existing mines is around 150 million ton, our Panchpatmali mines, and we are going to start one more mine, Pottangi mines, which is around 111 million tons. The mine will co me around 20 to 50 million tons , and that will last for another maybe 20 years

items.statement: Targets 1% EBITDA in Q4 FY26 and 1% EBITDA for full FY26 at consolidated level.
items.quote: So if you see -- if you ask me that FY '26 in the last quarter of this year, we target around 1% EBITDA. So in next year, in RetailerShakti, at consolidated level, tha t should be 1% EBITDA for the whole

items.statement: Aims for 7% EBITDA margin in SastaSundar and 4% in RetailerShakti by FY30, blended 4-5%.
items.quote: The FY '30, we are working towards in SastaSundar, an EBITDA margin of 7%. And in RetailerShakti, an EBITDA margin of around 4%. At blended, it should be around between 4% to 5%.

items.statement: Plans to invest INR150 crores in SastaSundar platform and warehouse capabilities, with INR40 crores already invested.
items.quote: So as in the last call, we have narrated that around INR150 crores, we'll be investing in building our SastaSundar platform business as w ell as building our warehouse capabilities. items.quote: So we invested last year INR35 crores. We projected INR35 crores. And similarly, we invested INR35 crores. The current year projection is around IN R50 crores and the working is going towards it only. So we will continue to invest INR50 crores

items.statement: Estimates 100% growth in B2C in FY26 from last year.
items.quote: No, in FY '26 in B2C growth, we estimate a growth of 100% from last year, and we have taken all the steps. And from the last year, this year, it should double.

items.statement: Targets EBITDA positive in RetailerShakti by end of this year, last quarter.
items.quote: But that efficiency will come in the current year. So we are working very closely to make it more sustainable and moving towards EBITDA positive business in the -- at least in the RetailerShakti business by end of this -- end of this year, in the last quarter.

items.statement: Targets EBITDA positive in RetailerShakti from this year, balancing scale and profitability.
items.quote: And our target is to move our EBITDA positive in the RetailerS hakti from this year. So maybe this year, we target a bit lower growth, but with profitability

items.statement: Launched JITO channel for generic medicines, offering up to 60% discount.
items.quote: This channel will give the customer discount up to 60%, if they opt for quality generic medicines. This we firmly believe that within the SastaSundar framework will go a very, very long way.

items.statement: Sees no substantial risk from consumer point of view; demand and digital adoption are tailwinds.
items.quote: So from consumer point of view, we don't find any substantial r isk. We see the major tailwind as demand from consumers for various integrated projects and di gital adoption is very rapidly doing very well

items.statement: Regulatory uncertainty about e-pharmacy; model is fit to adjust to changes.
items.quote: And from government side, yes, the government regulations are a little bit uncertain about e-pharmacy. But fr om since last 10 years, everybody is working. And in 2020 during COVID arena, the government supp orted in a written notification, the digital pharmacy

items.statement: Key risk is efficiency in execution model; closely monitoring to manage scale.
items.quote: The key risk we find is our efficiency in execution model. And we are closely monitoring that we are as efficient as in the past, and we can be able to manage the scale that we are getting into.

items.statement: Plans to simplify corporate structure by merging SastaSundar Healthbuddy Limited into holding company.
items.quote: We are working continuously on simplification of our corporate str ucture, and we hopefully will solve this simplification by merging SastaSundar Healthbuddy Li mited into our holding company

items.statement: Working capital days reduced from 35 days in Q4 FY24 to 23 days in Q4 FY25.
items.quote: So as the working capital days have been reduced sharply from 35 days in quarter 4 FY '24 to 23 days in quarter 4 FY '25, so what specific operational improvement drove this?

items.statement: Expects working capital efficiency to continue in FY26, but may fluctuate due to start-up phase.
items.quote: No, FY '26, we firmly believe that the current ongoing working capital efficiency will continue. We don't see any problem. But as I said earlier, that we are in a start-up phase.

items.statement: Plans to have around 400 Healthbuddy's working by current year-end.
items.quote: So around 150 Healthbuddy will be coming new. So 250 plus 150, 400. So by the current year-end, we should be having around 400 Healthbuddy's working very closely with SastaSundar network.

items.statement: Targets mid-teen revenue growth over medium term with stable EBITDA margins and ROCE expansion to high teens
items.quote: Now, as we enter our platform expansion phase, we are targeting mid-teen revenue growth over the medium term, driven by a balanced mix of organic and inorganic growth, while maintaining EBITDA margins at current levels.

items.statement: Expects 4-wheeler and CV revenue share to double from 12% in next 2-2.5 years
items.quote: Currently, 4-wheeler commercial and passenger segments contribute around 12% of our manufacturing revenue. Given our strong order book in these categories, we expect this share to double in the next 2 or 2.5 years.

items.statement: Approved capex plan of INR8,000 million over next two years for facility expansion and new programs
items.quote: The management has approved a capital expenditure plan of approximately INR8,000 million over the next two years. This will support facility expansion, asset upgrades and the development of infrastructure for new products and programs.

items.statement: Capex of INR8,000 million is an outer limit; expects actual spend to be lower
items.quote: Also, the INR800 crores capex or the INR8,000 million capex that we spoke about is an outer limit. We expect not to reach that or to be a little lower than what we've committed.

items.statement: Three new plants in Chennai, Bhiwadi, Pune; Chennai operational, Pune in trial, Bhiwadi to start Q2 FY26
items.quote: We're currently also establishing three manufacturing facilities in Chennai in Tamil Nadu, in Bhiwadi in Rajasthan and in Pune in Maharashtra. Commercial operations are underway in Chennai and trial production has already commenced at our Pune facility. Our Bhiwadi facility is on track to start in Q2 FY '26.

items.statement: Current capacity utilization ~65%; targets 73-74% over next 2-2.5 years
items.quote: We mentioned that on average our capacity utilization is at 65%. We plan to take it to 73 % to 74%.

items.statement: Order book spans 5 PV OEMs and 3 CV OEMs; skewed toward CV but PV orders expected to rise sharply
items.quote: The order book right now is maybe skewed a little more towards commercial vehicle OEMs, but now given our capabilities and high tensile steel in products like the cross-car beams and in products like the filtration technologies, we also expect passenger vehicle order book to rise sharply in the next few months.

items.statement: EBITDA margins expected to remain stable at current levels (12.3% consolidated, 14.2% manufacturing)
items.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 12.3% and are expected to remain stable in this range going ahead. Manufacturing EBITDA stood at INR9,372 million, a growth of 10% year-on-year, and manufacturing EBITDA margins remain stable at 14.2%.

items.statement: H-One EBITDA margins expected to align with Belrise manufacturing margins once capacity utilization improves
items.quote: I think the EBITDA margins that we expect from this business would be in line with the manufacturing EBITDA margins that we have in Belrise today.

items.statement: Raw material prices passed through quarterly/semi-annually via debit/credit notes; no profitability impact
items.quote: So our raw material prices are on a back-to-back basis. So, they get settled on a quarterly or semi-annual basis with our OEM. So, we are not exposed to any fluctuations in raw material prices in our business.

items.statement: Plans to increase 2-wheeler content per vehicle from INR12,500 to INR17,300 by adding 3 new products
items.quote: Our content per vehicle currently stands at INR12,500. We plan to increase this to INR17,300 over the next couple of years, by introducing three new products into our portfolio.

items.statement: Developing proprietary products (steering column, suspension, disc brakes, air filtration) with IP barriers
items.quote: Today, we are developing a range of proprietary products, both in -house and through collaborations, which have IP -based barriers to entry. T his involves increased investments in R&D, new product development and testing

items.statement: Top 3 customers + ecosystem = 67% of manufacturing revenue; single-source for many components
items.quote: The top three customers and their ecosystem vendors accounted for 67% of manufacturing revenue.

items.statement: Won 4 steering column orders from 3 marquee 2-wheeler OEMs and 1 European OEM in FY25
items.quote: Specifically on steering columns, we have won four orders from three marquee two-wheeler OEMs and one order from a large European OEM in FY25.

items.statement: H-One acquisition adds 2 state-of-the-art plants in Greater Noida and Bhiwadi with robotic welding, high-tonnage presses, in-house die making
items.quote: In terms of infrastructure, this acquisition has added two fully operational and very well-equipped, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Greater Noida, in UP, and in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan. These plants are equipped with robotic welding systems, high-tonnage press lines, and in-house die manufacturing setups.

items.statement: Repaid INR15,960M debt post-IPO (May 2025); will drive significant interest savings and improved debt ratios
items.quote: Following the successful IPO of our company in May 2025, the company has also repaid debt to the tune of INR15,960 million. This deleveraging will result in significant interest cost savings and improvement in debt ratios.

items.statement: EV revenue 4.0% of manufacturing revenue as of Mar 2025
items.quote: As of March '25, revenue from EVs stood at 4.0% of manufacturing revenues.

items.statement: Plants designed for zero liquid discharge; portion of energy from renewable sources; ESG a fundamental pillar
items.quote: Our plants are designed for zero liquid discharge, and a portion of our energy needs is met through renewable sources. Our ESG journey is a continuous one, and we consider it a fundamental pillar of our long-term sustainability and competitive advantage.

items.statement: Unable to comment on rare earth metal impact on customer production schedules; hopes situation resolves in weeks/months
items.quote: So, as of now, we are unable to comment on the exact customer schedules of our key customers. We do hope that the situation does sort itself out in terms of securing more rare earth metals access in the next few weeks or next few months.

items.statement: H-One had losses in FY25 due to low utilization; unabsorbed depreciation/losses may provide tax offsets in coming years
items.quote: To the other point, there are unabsorbed depreciation and losses that we can offset in the coming fiscal years a nd that may lead to a benefit in terms of taxes in the coming fiscal years

items.statement: H-One plants in Greater Noida/Bhiwadi provide hidden land value; spare land avoids new acquisitions in high-cost areas
items.quote: So naturally we would have had to acquire these lands on our own. But given that there is spare capacity and spare land available in H-One, we can avoid buying these new lands in these pretty high cost areas. So that's the hidden land value that we are talking about.

items.statement: Civil engineering order book recovered to USD 3.5 million as of 1st June from a low of ~USD 2 million 6-9 months ago
items.quote: Our order book size on the civil engineering, designing and drafting, which is our internal order booking is now close to 3.5 million as on 1st June.

items.statement: US civil construction activity slowed during election period but workflow improving from March; expects turnaround from Q1 FY26
items.quote: Since the election campaigning and elections started in the U.S., the majority of the projects were on hold till Jan-Feb and even in the month of -- from month of March we started seeing the flow of work improving.

items.statement: Targets FY26 PBT of INR 16 crores and PAT of INR 12 crores, matching FY25 levels
items.value: INR 16 crores PBT, INR 12 crores PAT
items.quote: we hope at least we will achieve the overall profitability which we did in 24-25, that is 24-25 we achieved INR16 crores overall profit, PBT, that is profit before tax and INR12 crores PAT.

items.statement: Expects to cross breakeven in Q1 FY26 and show meaningful improvement from Q2 FY26 onwards
items.quote: Probably in Q1 we will cross breakeven and show some positive result. And from Q2 onwards, we should be able to shoot up reasonably well.

items.statement: Current headcount ~1,069-1,169 with 900-1,000 productive engineers; full capacity revenue potential USD 25-30 million annually
items.quote: The revenue potential for this entire capacity is more than USD25 million to USD30 million, but filling that capacity consistently is a challenge.

items.statement: Utilization dropped to 55-60% over last 6 months; targets 75-80% for better performance
items.quote: Periodically, especially last 6 months, the utilization rate has fallen to almost 55%-60%. So, it should be at least 75%-80% levels so that the company performance would be much, much better.

items.statement: In advanced talks with New Jersey-based structural design firm; seeks partner commitment of 3-5 years; first acquisition is key to regional roll-up strategy
items.quote: Now we are in a position to talk to one client, one proposal in New Jersey area who are willing to work with us for 3 years. We are trying to ask for 5 years and that negotiation has just started.

items.statement: Interarch MOU: discussing 5-6 building projects (USD 0.5-1 million each) in RFQ stage; tariff clarity needed for conversion
items.quote: With Interarch, we have at least 5, 6 builders we are discussing as a total overall scenario, but still we are yet to make a first sale.

items.quote: Apart from that, we are eligible for 5% of commission, up to 5% of commission on the building cost itself -- whatever the export value of Interarch.

items.statement: BIW robotics design demand slowed as EV model launches stabilized; only minor cosmetic changes now; MES revenues impacted
items.quote: The majority of the reason for the slow growth in that area is new models of automobiles have slowed down in the number of varieties because there was a lot of activity couple of years ago for last 2 years wherein EV models were introduced rapidly, but now they are stabilizing on that and any changes coming only minor cosmetic changes are happening.

items.statement: Civil engineering focused on US market; MES services predominantly Europe (7-8 year relationships) with some US auto clients including Tesla Tier 1 suppliers
items.quote: Our civil buildings are focused only on US market, whereas our MES services are predominantly in Europe, because major automobile companies manufactured in Europe are related with us for last 7-8 years.

items.statement: Structural design revenue ~USD 600,000-700,000 (INR 5 crores) in FY25; similar run-rate currently
items.quote: It is somewhere hovering around $600,000 to $700,000 that's about INR5 crores for last year. Even this year also it is somewhere around that.

items.statement: Expects to double revenue in 3-4 years driven by MOUs, structural design acquisition, and new business lines
items.quote: Yes, we should be in 3-4 years, able to double our sales with all these MoUs and the new lines of activity we are entering in, because including structural design acquisition.

items.statement: Tariff confusion on steel/building imports delaying Interarch JV project conversions; clarity expected in 1-2 months
items.quote: Due to this confusion in the tariffs, the builders are not able to push forward. But couple of them has indicated that our pricing is very competitive, and they wish to go forward once they have some clarity on the tariffs.

items.statement: Downsized MES division over last 2 quarters; total headcount reduced ~40-50 over past year; hiring freeze lifted for Civil as traction picks up
items.quote: Currently we have downsized our MES to some extent during last couple of quarters. Now we have stopped any more reduction. Current employee strength continued to be close to 1,000-1,069. 1,169, which has tapered a little bit over the last 1-year not much maybe around 40-50 people overall reduction

items.statement: Target to double capacity to 2 million tons per annum by 2030 with silver capacity increasing to 1,500 tons per annum
items.quote: This growth will be supported by all the mines together by increasing the overall ore production to 31 million tons from the existing 19.3 million tons.

items.quote: And revenue, we arc expecting o cross anything between 60 to 65. That is what we are targeting.
